comparison_readiness.reason: personal review coverage is incomplete and the 2026 account period is not price-aligned with May 2023 household expenditure

dataset: Stats SA Income and Expenditure Survey 2022/23
estimand: annual household ordinary consumption where coicop_type == 1, May 2023 price basis

income_expenditure_association.interpretation: descriptive association only; no causal or inferential claim
income_expenditure_association.measure: survey-weighted Pearson correlation of log household income and log ordinary expenditure

limitations: Weighted estimates use household weights but do not include design-based variance estimates.
Provincial and subgroup results are descriptive and not causal.
Per-capita household values are not interpreted as observed individual expenditure.
PersonIncome is not aggregated into household income; the published household INCOME field is used.

weighting.method: aggregate unweighted item values to households, then apply HHOLD_WGT
weighting.variance_estimation: not performed because no supported design-variable variance procedure is implemented
